metadata.title: Gritty Urban Album Cover with Blackletter Overlay

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast urban portrait featuring a central figure obscured by digital distortion and overlaid with large, stylized blackletter typography and hand-drawn graffiti elements.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central human figure stands in a desaturated, high-contrast urban environment. The figure's head is obscured by a dark, scribbled texture. The entire image is treated with a coarse halftone dot pattern and film grain. Large, stylized blackletter text spans the center, featuring a warm-to-cool vertical gradient. A secondary hand-drawn 'tag' style logo is circled in the lower right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Large blackletter text dominates the mid-ground, overlapping the central figure.
The figure's dark, scribbled head creates a focal point of mystery and distortion.
A coarse halftone texture unifies the photographic background with the graphic overlays.
Warm orange and yellow accents in the text and shoes contrast against the cool blue and desaturated background.
coreInvariants: Coarse halftone dot pattern across the entire composition.
Scribbled, dark distortion obscuring the subject's face.
Vertical color gradient within the primary display typography.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body central figure, scaled to occupy the vertical center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, stylized blackletter title spanning the horizontal center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the distorted head, moves down to the large title, then follows the hand-drawn tag to the bright shoes at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, textured urban background provides high-contrast negative space for the light-colored text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated charcoal and black (background and shadows).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white and light grey (highlights and halftone mid-tones).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm orange-to-yellow gradient and soft cyan-blue highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with low overall saturation, except for the vibrant typography and footwear.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to urban, earthy, and industrial tones

letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast with thick verticals and thin horizontals
Modified 'y' and 'k' with elongated, expressive tails
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'L' features a sharp, dagger-like top terminal
The 'y' has a sweeping descender that underlines part of the word
The 'P' has a detached, floating top bowl
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of formal, aggressive blackletter with informal, fluid graffiti-style script.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the classic blackletter skeleton for modification
Strong verticality and sharp terminals matching the display style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, desaturated urban photo of a person in a suit. Apply a heavy halftone dot filter and obscure the face with a dense, black scribbled texture. Add a soft blue light source from the top left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay the primary title in a large blackletter font with an orange-to-white vertical gradient. Add a hand-drawn orange tag in the bottom right, circled with a rough oval and a small star icon.

verificationChecks: Is the halftone pattern visible across the entire image?
Is the face completely obscured by dark scribbles?
Does the main text have a vertical color gradient?
Is the 'Parental Advisory' logo present in the bottom right corner?

mustRedesign: Any legible facial features must be obscured
Generic fonts must be modified with custom spurs or tails
postGenerationChecks: Verify text legibility against the background
Ensure the gradient direction is vertical
Confirm the 'Parental Advisory' block is correctly placed
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Halftone Filter + Scribble Mask + Blackletter Gradient Title + Graffiti Tag Overlay
